user.title: Choose an Art Frame
user.description: Pick an Art Frame that is already set up in the SwitchBot Bluetooth integration.

account.title: SwitchBot account (optional)
account.description: Needed only for Show image, which puts new images on the frame without the SwitchBot app, and to keep SwitchBot's cloud album in step when images are deleted. Uses SwitchBot's private app API (as PySwitchbot does to get encryption keys); it isn't officially supported and could change. Google or Apple sign-in accounts won't work. Leave blank to skip.

reconfigure.title: SwitchBot account
reconfigure.description: Add, change or remove (leave both blank) the SwitchBot account used for Show image and for deleting images from SwitchBot's cloud album.

abort.no_art_frames: No Art Frames found. Set the frame up in the SwitchBot Bluetooth integration first.
abort.already_configured: Every Art Frame is already set up here.

error.invalid_auth: SwitchBot didn't accept that email and password.
error.account_incomplete: Enter both email and password, or leave both blank.
error.frame_not_in_account: Logged in, but this frame isn't in that SwitchBot account.

delete_image.name: Delete image
delete_image.description: Deletes one image stored on the Art Frame. If it is the image on display, the frame switches to the next image first.

image.name: Image
image.description: An image ID from the sensor's Image IDs attribute, or oldest, newest or current. (first and last are the same as oldest and newest.)

download_image.name: Download image
download_image.description: Tells the frame to fetch the image most recently uploaded to SwitchBot's cloud for it (for example with SwitchBot Cloud's Upload AI Art Frame image) and store it locally. The frame downloads over its own Wi-Fi; this replaces tapping Sync in the app.

image_id.name: Image ID
image_id.description: ID to store the image under. Leave empty to pick an unused one.

show.name: Show
show.description: Display the image once it has downloaded.

upload_image.name: Upload image (experimental)
upload_image.description: Uploads an image from a web address to SwitchBot's cloud for this frame, like SwitchBot Cloud's Upload AI Art Frame image, and returns SwitchBot's reply.

image_url.name: Image URL
image_url.description: Web address of the image. SwitchBot's servers fetch it, so it must be reachable from the internet.

show_image.name: Show image
show_image.description: Uploads an image to SwitchBot's cloud and has the frame fetch and display it, without the SwitchBot app. Give exactly one of an image URL, a file path or image data. Deletes the oldest image first if the frame is full. Needs a SwitchBot account added to this integration.

image_url.name: Image URL
image_url.description: Web address of the image. SwitchBot's servers fetch it, so it must be reachable from the internet.

image_path.name: Image file
image_path.description: Path to a PNG or JPEG file on the Home Assistant machine (in an allowed folder, such as /config/www or /media).

image_data.name: Image data
image_data.description: The image itself, base64-encoded, optionally as a data: URI.

make_room.name: Make room
make_room.description: If the frame already holds 10 images, delete the oldest first.
